content.title: Land Use and Zoning in Woodinville
content.summary: In Woodinville, land use is regulated by the Unified Development Code and related regulations to protect public health, safety, and welfare. The City reviews permit applications for compliance with land use regulations, environmental policies, and design standards.

steps.title: Understand Land Use Regulations
steps.text: Review the Unified Development Code and related development regulations to understand what activities are permitted on private property in Woodinville.

steps.title: Submit Permit Application
steps.text: Submit your land use permit application to the City for review by planners to ensure compliance with land use regulations, SEPA review, critical area regulations, and tree protection.

steps.title: City Planner Review
steps.text: City planners review the application for compliance with zoning, environmental policies, design review, Shoreline Master Program, and other land use regulations. Planners may also act as project managers for larger projects to facilitate the review process.
